title: Frozen versions
description: The shape of every contracts/<name>/frozen.json: the versions of that contract that are frozen (BP 3.3; 02-contracts section 2 items 10 and 11). The frozen-contract guard (infra/ci/contract-freeze-guard.mjs) reads it as it is on the base branch and fails a branch that edits or removes a file or fixture of a listed version, or drops a version from the list. The freeze record in words (date, consumer roles that reviewed) goes in the contract's README.md (item 11).

frozen.description: Frozen versions, oldest first. A version is only ever added, never removed.
